revisions.historicalContext: Jerusalem, Kingdom of Judah, late 8th century BCE: the hand-cut entrance of the rock tunnel beneath the City of David.

revisions.concept: Eli stands on the right side of the frame with both arms relaxed at his sides, amazed with an open mouth, facing a small bright hole that has just broken through the rough rock wall on the left, warm daylight shining through it into the dark tunnel. Simple dark background, clear empty top quarter, no lettering.
